title: 8. Her supplication for her devotees and the devotees of her progeny
categoryChain: Her supplications for herself and others for the world and the hereafter
8. Her supplication for her devotees and the devotees of her progeny
introduction:
Her supplication for her devotees and the devotees of her progeny

It is narrated that when she enters Paradise and looks at that honor that Allah has bestowed to her, she would recite:

Then Allah will reveal to Fatima: ‘Ask me whatever you desire, so that I may offer you that which will please you. Fatima will reply:

Allah will say: ‘O Fatima! I swear by My honor and My glory! I have sworn to Myself two thousand years before the creation of the Heavens and the Earth, that I shall not punish your Shia and Shia of your progeny in the hell-fire.’”

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ۔ اَلْحَـمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْٓ اَذْهَبَ عَنَّا الْحَزَنَ۝۰ۭ اِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُوْرٌ شَكُوْرُۨ۝۳۴ۙ الَّذِيْٓ اَحَلَّنَا دَارَ الْمُقَامَۃِ مِنْ فَضْلِهٖ۝۰ۚ لَا يَمَسُّـنَا فِيْهَا نَصَبٌ وَّلَا يَمَسُّـنَا فِيْهَا لُغُوْبٌ۝۳۵
اِلٰهِیْ اَنْتَ الْمُنٰي وَ فَوْقَ الْمُنٰي، اَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ لَا تُعَذِّبَ مُحِبِّیْ وَ مُحِبَّ عِتْرَتِیْ بِالنَّارِ۔
